_about: Models of OnePlus and OPPO earbuds from HeyMelody 117.6.6's bundled catalog (docs/oneplus/PROTOCOL.md): per model the names, the noise modes and sub-modes with their protocol indices, the equalizer presets with their protocol indices and English names, and feature flags. Facts only, written by tools/import_heymelody_catalog.py; the catalog itself stays outside the repo. Source analysis and a virtual run of the app (Buds Pro 2) only: no model here has been tried with PairFree.
